daily.today_energy: The cosmos is serving you authenticity vibes today. Trust your gut and let your natural magnetism do the talking—people are drawn to your raw energy right now.
daily.love: Your heart's speaking louder than usual. Whether you're single or taken, vulnerability is your superpower today. Let someone see the real you beneath the jokes.
daily.career: Mercury's got your back with clarity and communication flow. This is your moment to share ideas you've been sitting on. Your voice matters more than you think.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and presence. Dance, walk, stretch—anything that gets you connected to yourself. You're glowing from the inside when you honor what you need.

weekly.overview: Your cosmic energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been whispering. This week invites reflection over action—think of it as recalibrating your internal compass before the next big move.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a softness in the air around your heart space. If you've been holding back from being vulnerable, this is your gentle nudge to let someone see the real you.
weekly.career: Your professional vibe is less about hustle and more about alignment right now. Trust that the moves you're making are building toward something solid, even if the progress feels quiet or behind-the-scenes.
weekly.health: Your body might be asking for more rest than usual—listen to that. Consider this week an invitation to check in with your energy levels and do things that genuinely feel nourishing, not just productive.
